text: A tawanooka ka senngo Fello Tuuri, fewndo Men noddunoo Muusaa, Men wahayini e makko, sakko humpitaa fii ɗum. Ko woni, Men nuliri yurmeende wonannde yimɓe ɓen, Men wahayini e maaɗa, kumpite mun ɗen, fii no jertiniraa yimɓe, ɓe Nulaaɗo jeertiniroowo ɓe no ɓe waajitora araali e maɓɓe, ado maaɗa, ɓe gomɗina ko addan-ɗaa ɓe kon immorde ka Alla.
